name: Xizor
description: Xizor (pronounced /shē'zōr/) was a Falleen Prince of House Sizhran and the Underlord of the powerful criminal syndicate Black Sun during the Galactic Civil War. He was a ruthless competitor and charismatic public figure in high society with his headquarters in the city planet Coruscant. Close to the Imperial Palace, but less splendid, was Xizor's Palace, his home outside Falleen and a testimony of his status.
